notes: Design not named; cross-sectional with trend inferred from repeated annual NIS samples. Group 'higher than' claims rest on omnibus Rao-Scott tests; no pairwise tests reported. Race n_groups counts six named groups, excluding Missing, which may or may not have entered the test.
